watch.label: Randy Rides Alone (1934), Internet Archive, 52 min

editorial:
Randy Rides Alone is a 1934 John Wayne western from Lone Star Productions, directed by Harry L. Fraser and released June 5, 1934. Wayne plays Randy Bowers, who is arrested for murders he did not commit. George Hayes appears as Marvin Black, and Yakima Canutt plays the henchman Spike. The Internet Archive copy runs about 52 minutes and is tagged Creative Commons Public Domain, which is the uploader's label and not a legal finding.

The rights trap is the missing renewal check. A 1934 film is free today only if its copyright was not renewed in the 28th year, so the 1961-1962 renewal volumes decide the print. This dossier did not read those volumes or search the Copyright Office catalog, so the print stays undetermined. The soundtrack follows the film's status. The player-piano tune 'Sobre las Olas' is a separate composition that was not checked.
faq: Can I use Randy Rides Alone in my own project?

Not yet on this dossier's evidence. The print's status turns on whether a renewal was filed in the 1961-1962 window, and that was not confirmed here. Check the Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes linked above and the Copyright Office public catalog before reusing it.
Does an Internet Archive public-domain tag settle the question?
No. The tag is set by the uploader. Confirm the renewal absence yourself, then use the print. A modern copy that adds a new score, titles or other material may carry protection for those additions.
